points: The abacus: used over 2,000 years ago

points: Ada Lovelace wrote a program for one (1843)

timeline.text: World Wide Web opens to the public

model.title: Was the World Wide Web a turning point?

parts.text: So: it changed how people learn, shop and talk

questions.q: Order: World Wide Web, abacus, printing press, telephone.
questions.a: Abacus, printing press (about 1440), telephone (1876), World Wide Web (1991)

questions.q: Core: Make an illustrated technology timeline (objects only, no people) with six inventions, dates and one sentence on each impact.
questions.a: Six correct inventions, dates and impacts

questions.q: Extend: Circle two turning points and explain why.
questions.a: For example: printing press (books for many), the Web (worldwide sharing)

questions.q: Stretch: Which invention do you think will be next? Why?

questions.a: B) Abacus. The abacus is over 2,000 years old.

questions.a: A justified choice using its impact
